title: Kill This Empire (DnD + CK3), I would like some feedback please
author: Tumeshka-gamedev
selftext:
[https://tumeshka.itch.io/kill-the-empire](https://tumeshka.itch.io/kill-the-empire)

How it's made:

\- Art: generated, then cut up and rebuilt as a paper-collage look so the cast and backdrops match

\- Voices: generated (ElevenLabs), a few hundred voiced lines in the demo

\- Music and sounds: generated

\- Code: written with AI help, Electron for the desktop build

comments.author: TheBigQuestion354
comments.body:
1. Dialogue is pretty clearly AI written "Keep me, and I'll even use the door" makes zero sense in context and is recognizable AI speech. AI isn't great for writing so you will either need to edit or write all of the dialogue in the game. Not saying this as "anti" saying this as I am going through the same.  
2. Character's look cool but the animations are really stiff and could use some work.  
3. By combined with DnD do you just mean a d20 system?  
Overall I like the world map and you have an interesting concept but certain areas are for sure more polished than others.

replies.author: DeXeSLTU
replies.body:
Here are some of the things I managed to find, though I didn't spend enough time to fully dive deeper into the game. I hope at least some of it will be useful :)

* **Missing loading screen**.
* **Support for ultrawide monitors:** On my monitor, some windows look strange. At the very least, just add black bars.
* **Nation selection:** Instead of showing people at the start of the game, have something like "Nations" (Select your Nation).
* **Text highlighting:** Important parts of the text are not highlighted everywhere.
* **UI scaling:** At least to me, all buttons and text look too small.
* **UI clarity:** The UI is a bit confusing, and I am constantly afraid that I missed something I needed to do. Maybe split the UI into multiple parts and initially display only the sections that are relevant at that specific time?
* **Character menu shortcut:** Make left-clicking the main character's thumbnail open the menu instead of right-clicking; at first, I thought clicking on it did nothing.
* **UI borders:** Change border lines to something like SVG lines, as their current resolution is too low.
* **Camera bug:** There is a bug that pushes me away if I rotate the camera close to the map border.
* **Time indicator:** It would be nice to have a time-of-day indicator.
* **Area inspection:** It would be nice if I could hover over an area to have the entire zone highlighted, and clicking it would give me detailed information about that area rather than just a few lines describing it and the ruler.
* **Minigame tutorials:** There are no tutorials for minigames.
* **Bonus actions and taxes:** Bonus actions look confusing—why can I only use one at a time? Also, collecting taxes should probably be automatic.
* **Map diversity:** The map could be more interesting with more points of interest. Which are visually different, maybe some kind of volcano, a burned area, blue glowing trees some kind of fantasy elements and some interesting effects. In general, just something that would catch my eye, as right now it feels a bit monotonous.
